meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
India mein **oily skin** ke liye ₹500 ke andar sabse safe aur practical picks ye hain: **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash**, **Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash**, aur **Cetaphil Oily Skin Cleanser**.[3][6][13]

Agar aapko *ek hi recommendation* chahiye, to **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash** best all-round option lagta hai oily skin aur acne-prone skin ke liye, kyunki is category mein salicylic acid oil control aur clogged pores ke liye commonly recommended ingredient hai.[3][6]  
Agar skin **sensitive** hai aur aapko harsh cleanser nahi chahiye, to **Cetaphil Oily Skin Cleanser** better choice ho sakta hai.[13]  
Agar aapko **budget-friendly** option chahiye, to **Garnier Pure Active Neem Face Wash** bhi ₹500 se kaafi neeche milta hai.[3]

Simple comparison:

| Product | Best for | Approx. price |
|---|---|---|
| **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash** | Oily + acne-prone skin | ₹299–₹399[3][6] |
| **Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash** | Oil control + everyday use | ₹300–₹350[3] |
| **Cetaphil Oily Skin Cleanser** | Sensitive oily skin | ₹389[13] |
| **Garnier Pure Active Neem Face Wash** | Lowest-budget pick | ₹150–₹200[3] |

Agar aapki skin **bahut oily + pimples/blackheads** wali hai, to **salicylic acid** wala face wash zyada suitable hota hai.[3][6]  
Agar aap chahein, main aapke **skin type + budget + available brands** ke hisaab se 3 best options short list kar deta hoon.
